title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 2c
description: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 2c — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Report back to Sir Ving in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 3

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Report back to Sir Ving in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Someone's been giving me bad King's Coins? I didn't even notice! Oh dear!

Lower Shadow's Embrace, you say? Let me check my records. Yes, I have several exchanges from someone on Level 5 of the Shadow's Embrace. That must be the criminal behind these counterfeits!

If there's anything you or Sir Ving can do to help, I would appreciate it! You can even have all my sales receipts to help with your investigation!

Turn-in:

Did you, perchance, bring me a sandwich? I've been standing here for ever-so-long and am getting a bit peckish. No? Well, I suppose it is all the better, to help me keep my athletic figure.

Objectives:

  • Sales Receipts ×1

Level range: 47–100
